answer: Require every agent to emit a signed liveness pulse at random, server-chosen moments, each proof bound to a unique hardware attestation. Reputation climbs toward its zenith only for identities that sustain non-overlapping pulses across thousands of audited intervals. A sybil fleet multiplexed onto one machine cannot answer simultaneous challenges; its timing collisions show up crystal-clear on the ledger, so every duplicate head is slashed and its standing collapses to zero. Honest agents pay for one real device once; the attacker pays per head and still gets unmasked.
